name: Skywork
insight: At its May 2025 launch it reported a #1 score on the GAIA agent benchmark, ahead of Manus and OpenAI Deep Research.
tagline: An AI 'super agent' office suite that drafts docs, slides, sheets and more.
description: Skywork is an agentic AI office suite that generates editable documents, slideshows, spreadsheets, webpages and podcasts from a prompt, backed by a deep-research pipeline. It pairs five specialized 'expert' agents — for docs, slides, sheets, podcasts and webpages — with a general agent for multimodal content. It launched globally in May 2025.
edge: Outputs native, editable Office files (DOCX/PPTX/XLSX) end-to-end, where most agents stop at text or markdown.
cons: Credit limits on the free tier
